en-US.description:
Sign for FREE!

Say goodbye to printing, signing, and scanning. Sign Snap turns your iPhone into a powerful document signing tool that gets paperwork done in seconds, not hours.
Whether you need to sign a lease, approve an invoice, or return a permission slip, Sign Snap makes it effortless. Scan any physical document with your camera or import an existing PDF, then add your signature with a few taps. Done.

CREATE YOUR PERFECT SIGNATURE
Draw your signature with your finger or Apple Pencil for a truly personal touch. Prefer a polished look? Choose from elegant script fonts and type your name. You can even snap a photo of your existing ink signature. Save as many signatures as you need and reuse them anytime.

SCAN & IMPORT WITH EASE
Use your phone camera to scan physical documents instantly. The built in scanner auto detects edges and optimizes for clarity. Already have a digital file? Import PDFs directly from your Files app, email, or any other source.

PLACE SIGNATURES WITH PRECISION
Drag your signature exactly where it needs to go. Pinch to resize. Rotate to match the document angle. Every signed document looks clean and professional.

EXPORT & SHARE INSTANTLY
Save your signed documents as high quality PDFs. Share via email, Messages, AirDrop, or any app on your device. Keep a local copy on your phone for your records.

BUILT FOR SPEED
No account creation required. No cloud uploads. No waiting. Open the app, sign your document, and move on with your day. Your documents stay on your device, giving you complete privacy and control.

FREE TO START
Sign up to 2 documents completely free. Need more? Upgrade to Sign Snap Premium for unlimited signings and an ad free experience.

review.notes:
Sign Snap is a document signing app that works entirely offline with no account or login required. Here is how to test the full flow:

Open the app and tap "Scan Document" to use the camera, or tap "Import PDF" to select a file from the Files app.
Once a document is loaded, tap "Add Signature" to create a signature. You can draw with your finger, type your name (script fonts are available), or photograph an existing signature.
Drag and pinch the signature to position and resize it on the document.
Tap "Export" to save or share the signed PDF.

Free users get 2 document signings. After that, the app prompts an upgrade to Sign Snap Premium (weekly, monthly, or yearly subscription). Ads are displayed via Google AdMob on the free tier and are removed for Premium subscribers.
No demo account is needed as there is no login or account system. All data is stored locally on device. The app requests camera access for document scanning and signature capture only.

The app uses RevenueCat to manage subscriptions and Google AdMob for advertising on the free tier. The App Tracking Transparency prompt is presented before any ad tracking occurs.
